mechanism: Isotretinoin is highly teratogenic and oral contraceptives may have reduced efficacy due to potential enterohepatic circulation alterations, creating significant risk of contraceptive failure and severe fetal abnormalities.
action: Isotretinoin is absolutely contraindicated in women of childbearing potential unless on two forms of contraception; ethinyl estradiol alone is insufficient and must be combined with a second contraceptive method, with pregnancy tests required monthly.
